from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fill = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    def mode(values):
        return Counter(values).most_common(1)[0][0]

    rows = [r for r in range(h) if mode(grid[r]) != fill]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if mode([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) != fill]

    # Keep separator coordinates whose dominant color differs from the interior fill.
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    intersections = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    line_color = mode([x for row in intersections for x in row])

    marked = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(intersections)
              for j, value in enumerate(row) if value != line_color]
    if marked:
        r0 = min(i for i, _ in marked)
        r1 = max(i for i, _ in marked)
        c0 = min(j for _, j in marked)
        c1 = max(j for _, j in marked)
    else:
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = 0, len(rows) - 1, 0, len(cols) - 1

    out = []
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        line = []
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            corners = (intersections[i][j], intersections[i][j + 1],
                       intersections[i + 1][j], intersections[i + 1][j + 1])
            if corners[0] != line_color and all(x == corners[0] for x in corners):
                line.append(corners[0])
            else:
                line.append(fill)
        out.append(line)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    def mode(values):
        return Counter(values).most_common(1)[0][0]

    fill = mode([v for row in grid for v in row])
    line_rows = [r for r in range(h) if mode(grid[r]) != fill]
    line_cols = [c for c in range(w) if mode([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) != fill]

    if len(line_rows) < 2 or len(line_cols) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    # The dominant color on the separator rows is the separator color;
    # special colors occur only at some grid intersections.
    line_color = mode([mode(grid[r]) for r in line_rows])
    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in line_cols] for r in line_rows]

    marked = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(nodes)
              for j, value in enumerate(row) if value != line_color]
    if not marked:
        return []

    r0 = min(i for i, _ in marked)
    r1 = max(i for i, _ in marked)
    c0 = min(j for _, j in marked)
    c1 = max(j for _, j in marked)

    out = []
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        row = []
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            a, b = nodes[i][j], nodes[i][j + 1]
            c, d = nodes[i + 1][j], nodes[i + 1][j + 1]
            row.append(a if a != line_color and a == b == c == d else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
